--ब्दः
1 A cloud.
--2 A year (in this sense n. also).
--3 N. of a grass (मुस्ता).
--4 N. of a
mountain
--Comp.
--अर्धं half a year.
--वाहनः N. of Śiva.
--शतं a century.

आब्द a. (ब्दी f.) [अब्द-अण्]
Belonging to, or produced from, a
cloud.

अब्दया adv. Ved. With a desire to
give water.

अब्दिः Ved. A cloud; ˚भृत्
possessed of clouds; giving water, as a
cloud.

अब्दुर्गः A fortress in water, one
surrounded by a moat or lake.

आब्दिक a. (की f.) [अब्द-ठक्]
Annual, yearly; आब्दिकः करः
